**Search executed:** FamilySearch — Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1740–1900 (log_006)

| Q7FB-T45 | Patrick Flynn | Thomas Flynn & Mary Gallagher | 12 Mar 1845 | 0.68 |
| Q7FB-M45 | Patrick Flynn | Michael Flynn & Ellen Walsh | 3 Jun 1845 | 0.67 |

**Problem:** Both candidates are in the same parish, same year, with virtually identical match scores. Neither can be favored over the other without an external anchor.

**Status:** `pli_007` updated to `in_progress`. A namesake pool (ns_001) was recorded for subject I1 — the two entries are logged as candidates, but no extraction was made because the identity question is unresolved.

**What's needed next:** A record that independently names Patrick Flynn's father — his death certificate, his marriage record, or a child's birth certificate from Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania — is required before one of these baptism entries can be extracted and linked to the subject.

Next, a record that names Patrick's father — such as his death certificate, his marriage record, or one of his children's birth certificates — needs to be found to determine which of these two baptism entries belongs to him.
